Here is a draft follow-up email based on your meeting notes:

Subject: Follow-Up on Our Discovery Call

Dear [Rep's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. Thank you for taking the time to engage with Morgan Vega from Blue Harbor Events during our recent product discovery call. It was a productive discussion that highlighted several key points regarding their operations and needs.

Morgan coordinates two venues and oversees thirty planners, which presents a unique set of challenges. One notable issue mentioned was the frequent loss of handover notes between teams, indicating a need for improved communication and organization tools. Morgan expressed interest in a short product walkthrough to explore potential solutions that could streamline their processes.

As a next step, we propose offering a twenty-minute call next Tuesday to provide the requested walkthrough. Please confirm if this timing works for Morgan.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
Aster Works
